source.text_it: Durante la percorrenza di una curva, il differenziale consente di trasferire parte della velocità di rotazione dalla ruota motrice esterna a quella interna alla curva

records.localized_text: On a bend, the differential transfers part of the rotational speed from the outer drive wheel to the inner drive wheel.

source.text_it: Il sincronizzatore è un dispositivo che fa parte del cambio di velocità e che consente di far girare l'albero motore e quello di trasmissione alla stessa velocità

records.localized_text: A gearbox synchronizer makes the crankshaft and transmission shaft rotate at the same speed.

source.text_it: Se un cambio di velocità è dotato di sincronizzatori delle marce, diventa inutile la presenza della frizione

records.localized_text: If a gearbox has gear synchronizers, a clutch becomes unnecessary.

source.text_it: Il volano è un pesante disco, collegato all'albero motore, che serve come base di appoggio per il disco della frizione, nonché per avviare e per regolarizzare la rotazione dell'albero motore

records.localized_text: The flywheel is a heavy disc connected to the crankshaft that supports the clutch disc, starts the engine and smooths crankshaft rotation.

source.text_it: Il volano serve ad aumentare la velocità di rotazione del motore quando il veicolo deve effettuare grossi sforzi (ad esempio: salita ripida)

records.localized_text: The flywheel increases engine rpm when the vehicle must exert great effort, such as on a steep ascent.

source.text_it: Ogni asse motore è dotato di un differenziale

records.localized_text: Each drive axle has a differential.

source.text_it: Il differenziale trasmette il moto alle ruote tramite due semiassi

records.localized_text: The differential transmits motion to the wheels through two half-shafts.

source.text_it: Il differenziale è un ripartitore di giri tra le ruote motrici di uno stesso asse

records.localized_text: The differential distributes rotational speed between drive wheels on the same axle.

source.text_it: Il differenziale contiene olio lubrificante che deve venire periodicamente sostituito

records.localized_text: The differential contains lubricating oil that must be changed periodically.

source.text_it: Il differenziale permette alle ruote motrici di avere diversa velocità una rispetto all’altra

records.localized_text: The differential allows drive wheels to rotate at different speeds.

source.text_it: L’albero di trasmissione deve essere molto rigido per impedire le oscillazioni del differenziale

records.localized_text: The transmission shaft must be very rigid to prevent differential oscillation.

source.text_it: Il differenziale non può essere sull'asse delle ruote direttrici

records.localized_text: A differential cannot be on the steering-wheel axle.

source.text_it: Il differenziale non si trova mai sui veicoli adatti a percorsi fuori-strada perché è troppo delicato e potrebbe essere danneggiato dai sobbalzi

records.localized_text: A differential is never fitted to off-road vehicles because it is too delicate and could be damaged by jolts.

source.text_it: Se un asse è dotato di ruote gemellate deve avere due differenziali

records.localized_text: An axle with dual wheels must have two differentials.

source.text_it: Il differenziale non viene montato sui veicoli da cava o cantiere perché è troppo delicato

records.localized_text: Differentials are not fitted to quarry or construction vehicles because they are too delicate.

source.text_it: Al posto del differenziale può essere montata la coppia conica

records.localized_text: A bevel gear pair can be installed instead of a differential.

source.text_it: Se il cambio è automatico, il differenziale è inserito al suo interno

records.localized_text: With an automatic gearbox, the differential is inside it.

source.text_it: La frizione fa parte degli organi di trasmissione

records.localized_text: The clutch is a transmission component.

source.text_it: La frizione può essere di tipo monodisco a secco

records.localized_text: A clutch may be a dry single-disc type.

source.text_it: In alcuni autoveicoli la frizione si innesta automaticamente

records.localized_text: In some vehicles, the clutch engages automatically.

source.text_it: In alcuni autoveicoli il comando della frizione è automatico

records.localized_text: In some vehicles, the clutch is automatically controlled.

source.text_it: La frizione può essere ad attrito meccanico, idraulica, elettroidraulica o elettromagnetica

records.localized_text: A clutch may be mechanical friction, hydraulic, electrohydraulic or electromagnetic.

source.text_it: La frizione può essere del tipo a disco unico o a dischi multipli

records.localized_text: A clutch may be single-disc or multi-disc.

source.text_it: La frizione a dischi multipli è adatta soprattutto per i veicoli di massa e/o potenza elevate

records.localized_text: A multi-disc clutch is especially suitable for high-mass and/or high-power vehicles.

source.text_it: La frizione può essere di tipo automatico

records.localized_text: A clutch may be automatic.

rows.text: On a bend, the outer wheel travels farther and rotates faster than the inner one. The differential allows this difference; it does not transfer speed from the outer wheel to the inner one.
evidence: Eaton, Differentials, https://www.eaton.com/us/en-us/products/differentials-traction-control.html: il differenziale permette alle ruote dell’asse motore di girare indipendentemente.
Eaton, Detroit Gearless, https://www.eaton.com/us/en-us/catalog/differentials/detroit-gearless-locking-differential.html: in curva la ruota esterna gira più veloce.

rows.text: The synchronizer brings the selected gear and its gearbox shaft to the same speed, making engagement easier. It does not equalize crankshaft and driveshaft speeds.
evidence: ZF, 90 Years of All-Synchronous Transmission, https://www.zf.com/mobile/en/company/strategy/heritage_zf/stories/all_synchronous_transmission.html: sincronizza ingranaggio e albero del cambio; il guidatore usa la frizione.

rows.text: The synchronizer matches speeds inside the gearbox to facilitate shifting; the clutch connects and disconnects the engine and transmission. Synchronization does not make the clutch unnecessary.
evidence: ZF, 90 Years of All-Synchronous Transmission, https://www.zf.com/mobile/en/company/strategy/heritage_zf/stories/all_synchronous_transmission.html: sincronizza ingranaggio e albero del cambio; il guidatore usa la frizione.
ZF, Installing Clutches, https://aftermarket.zf.com/en/aftermarket-portal/knowledge-hub/installing-clutches/: frizione di un cambio manuale.

rows.text: The flywheel is attached to the crankshaft; its inertia smooths variations in rotation. It provides a clutch surface and a ring gear for the starter motor.
evidence: ZF, Replace flywheel when changing clutch, https://press.zf.com/press/en/releases/release_28224.html: volano massiccio con superficie di attrito e corona per il motorino di avviamento; ZF, Torsional Damper, https://www.zf.com/products/en/cars/products_64271.html: collegamento all’albero motore.

Islamic University of Technology, Flywheel, https://repository.iutoic-dhaka.edu/server/api/core/bitstreams/ed394255-5ade-4eb3-a5f1-3a058d225d51/content: il volano accumula energia e regolarizza la velocità dell’albero motore.

rows.text: The flywheel stores energy and smooths changes in crankshaft speed; it does not automatically increase engine speed when effort rises on a hill.
evidence: Islamic University of Technology, Flywheel, https://repository.iutoic-dhaka.edu/server/api/core/bitstreams/ed394255-5ade-4eb3-a5f1-3a058d225d51/content: accumulo di energia e regolarizzazione della velocità dell’albero motore.

rows.text: The quiz marks this TRUE: a conventional driven axle uses a differential to let its wheels turn at different speeds in bends. Some independently driven wheel-motor systems need no mechanical differential.
evidence: Official superiori question 29665 retains its printed verdict.
Protean https://www.proteanelectric.com/wheel-torque-and-speed-in-vehicles-with-in-wheel-motors/ : independently driven wheel motors can manage wheel speeds without mechanical differential.

rows.text: In a drive axle, the differential transmits motion to both sides through two half-shafts, one on each side.
evidence: Eaton, Differentials, https://www.eaton.com/us/en-us/products/differentials-traction-control.html: il differenziale permette alle ruote dell’asse motore di girare indipendentemente.

Eaton, Differentials Owner’s Manual, sezione 5, https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/differentials-traction-control/Eaton-differentials-owners-manual.pdf: i semiassi sono collegati agli ingranaggi laterali.

rows.text: The differential distributes motion between the two sides of the drive axle and allows them to turn at different speeds, as needed on a bend.
evidence: Eaton, Differentials, https://www.eaton.com/us/en-us/products/differentials-traction-control.html: il differenziale permette alle ruote dell’asse motore di girare indipendentemente.

rows.text: The differential gears are lubricated with oil. Change it according to the manufacturer’s intervals and specifications.
evidence: Eaton, ELocker Installation Instructions, p. 2, https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/differentials-traction-control/elocker/ELocker_Installation_Instructions_July_2004.pdf: usare il lubrificante e gli intervalli raccomandati dal costruttore.

rows.text: On a bend, the wheels on the same axle travel different distances; the differential lets them rotate at different speeds while transmitting motion.
evidence: Eaton, Differentials, https://www.eaton.com/us/en-us/products/differentials-traction-control.html: il differenziale permette alle ruote dell’asse motore di girare indipendentemente.

rows.text: The driveshaft carries motion to the axle; it does not prevent the differential from moving. Joints allow operation even when the connected components are not aligned.
evidence: Dana Spicer, Driveline Operating Angle Calculator, https://spicerparts.com/en-emea/calculators/driveline-operating-angle-calculator: i giunti operano con angoli tra albero e organi collegati.

rows.text: An axle can both steer and drive the wheels; it can then have a differential to distribute motion to them.
evidence: Dana Spicer, Jeep, https://spicerparts.com/en-emea/jeep: asse anteriore per Jeep Wrangler con differenziale e giunti dei semiassi.

rows.text: Off-road vehicles can also have differentials, sometimes lockable to improve traction. Rough terrain does not rule out their use.
evidence: Volvo Trucks, FMX construction, https://www.volvotrucks.com/en-en/news-stories/press-releases/2020/oct/volvo-trucks-celebrates-ten-years-in-the-construction-industry.html: camion da cantiere con bloccaggi dei differenziali.

rows.text: Dual wheels are paired on the same side of an axle; they do not require a differential for each wheel. One differential can serve both sides of the axle.
evidence: Eaton, Differentials, https://www.eaton.com/us/en-us/products/differentials-traction-control.html: differenziale fra i due lati del ponte.

Ford, Super Duty F-350 configurator, https://www.ford.com/build-price/superduty/choose-model/build?complex=true&config=-666736416923439716&configId=USASuperduty2027&trimConfig=-2677189529081503239&vehicleTrim=f-350xl: ruote posteriori gemellate e singolo ponte posteriore con differenziale.

rows.text: Construction vehicles can also have differentials; locking systems are available for difficult terrain.
evidence: Volvo Trucks, FMX construction, https://www.volvotrucks.com/en-en/news-stories/press-releases/2020/oct/volvo-trucks-celebrates-ten-years-in-the-construction-industry.html: camion da cantiere con bloccaggi dei differenziali.

rows.text: The bevel gear pair and differential have different jobs: the gear pair transmits and reduces the drive to the axle, while the differential permits different wheel speeds. They are not interchangeable.
evidence: Eaton, Differentials, https://www.eaton.com/us/en-us/products/differentials-traction-control.html: il differenziale permette alle ruote dell’asse motore di girare indipendentemente.

Eaton, Differentials Owner’s Manual, sezione 5, https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/differentials-traction-control/Eaton-differentials-owners-manual.pdf: corona, pignone e ingranaggi del differenziale coesistono.

rows.text: An automatic gearbox does not require the differential to be inside it. The layout depends on the vehicle and may place the differential separately in the axle.
evidence: Ford, Super Duty F-350 configurator, https://www.ford.com/build-price/superduty/choose-model/build?complex=true&config=-666736416923439716&configId=USASuperduty2027&trimConfig=-2677189529081503239&vehicleTrim=f-350xl: cambio automatico e ponte posteriore con differenziale.
Ford, Glossary, https://www.ford.com/help/glossary/: albero trasmette il moto dal cambio al differenziale del ponte posteriore.

rows.text: The clutch connects and disconnects the engine and gearbox, controlling the flow of motion; it is therefore part of the transmission.
evidence: ZF, 90 Years of All-Synchronous Transmission, https://www.zf.com/mobile/en/company/strategy/heritage_zf/stories/all_synchronous_transmission.html: sincronizza ingranaggio e albero del cambio; il guidatore usa la frizione.
ZF, Installing Clutches, https://aftermarket.zf.com/en/aftermarket-portal/knowledge-hub/installing-clutches/: frizione e albero d’ingresso del cambio.

rows.text: A dry single-disc clutch uses one friction disc operating without an oil bath; it is one possible design.
evidence: ZF, TraXon DynamicPerform, https://www.zf.com/products/en/special_vehicles/products_64422.html: confronto fra frizione monodisco a secco e multidisco a bagno d’olio.

rows.text: In automated manual transmissions, an actuator controls the clutch and can engage it without the driver operating a pedal.
evidence: ZF, Automated Manual Transmission, https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_64551.html: azionamento automatico di frizione e cambio.

rows.text: In some vehicles, electronics command an actuator that controls the clutch instead of leaving direct control to the driver.
evidence: ZF, Automated Manual Transmission, https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_64551.html: azionamento automatico di frizione e cambio.
ZF, ConAct, https://www.zf.com/products/nl/cv/products_64155.html: la centralina regola l’attuatore della frizione.

rows.text: There are friction clutches and systems using fluids, electrohydraulic controls or electromagnetic controls. The classification can refer either to how motion is transmitted or to how the clutch is actuated.
evidence: EPO, EP2979911A1, par. 0011, https://data.epo.org/publication-server/rest/v1.2/publication-dates/20160203/patents/EP2979911NWA1/document.pdf: attuatori elettromagnetici o elettroidraulici di frizione per veicoli.
ZF, TraXon 2, https://www.zf.com/products/en/special_vehicles/products_64406.html?pageLink=contact_divider658792: frizione a secco e modulo con convertitore di coppia.

rows.text: There are single-disc and multi-disc clutches; the latter add friction surfaces to transmit torque.
evidence: Schaeffler, Clutch Modules, sezioni 2 e 3, https://vehiclelifetimesolutions.schaeffler.com/medias/BR-0007-en.PDF?context=bWFzdGVyfGRvY3VtZW50c3wzNDMxMTY0fGFwcGxpY2F0aW9uL3BkZnxkb2N1bWVudHMvaDE5L2gyZC85MzA1NTc1NzE4OTQyLnBkZnwwYzM2NTU3MzdlZGQ2YzY0YWZiNTE0MGZlN2E5ZjMzNTE5ZmY1YzdhYWM0Y2UxMzcyNmFkNTU2NGJmOTFkYzdk: moduli mono e multidisco; più dischi aumentano la coppia trasmissibile.

rows.text: More discs provide more friction surfaces and can increase the torque that can be transmitted, making this design suitable for demanding applications.
evidence: Schaeffler, Clutch Modules, sezioni 2 e 3, https://vehiclelifetimesolutions.schaeffler.com/medias/BR-0007-en.PDF?context=bWFzdGVyfGRvY3VtZW50c3wzNDMxMTY0fGFwcGxpY2F0aW9uL3BkZnxkb2N1bWVudHMvaDE5L2gyZC85MzA1NTc1NzE4OTQyLnBkZnwwYzM2NTU3MzdlZGQ2YzY0YWZiNTE0MGZlN2E5ZjMzNTE5ZmY1YzdhYWM0Y2UxMzcyNmFkNTU2NGJmOTFkYzdk: moduli mono e multidisco; più dischi aumentano la coppia trasmissibile.
ZF, TraXon 2, https://www.zf.com/products/en/special_vehicles/products_64406.html?pageLink=contact_divider658792: frizione multidisco di avviamento per veicoli pesanti.

rows.text: A clutch can be controlled automatically: an actuator engages and disengages it under the transmission system’s control.
evidence: ZF, Automated Manual Transmission, https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_64551.html: azionamento automatico di frizione e cambio.

review.author: gpt-6.1-terra / collaboration /root/terra_author
reviewer_evidence: Protean wheel-motor technical article independently inspected; an individual-wheel motor arrangement can function without a conventional mechanical differential. ERIC manual /tmp/rotonda-eric-ed246299.pdf pp. 268–269 describes conventional axle and locking differential.

issues.reason: Il quesito afferma senza condizioni che ogni asse motore ha un differenziale e riporta VERO; Eaton descrive configurazioni elettriche con un motore per ruota che non richiedono differenziale. Non è chiarito se il quesito intenda esclusivamente il ponte motore convenzionale.
checked_sources: Ministero, quiz superiori, quesito 29665, https://www.ilportaledellautomobilista.it/documents/56611/85457073/DomandeSuperiori.pdf/7725566d-e40f-4583-ad74-db4395d103cf: affermazione universale e verdetto VERO.

Eaton, Does an electric vehicle need a limited slip differential?, https://www.eaton.com/au/en-gb/support/eaton-answers/limited-slip-differentials-and-electric-vehicles.html: un motore per singola ruota non richiede differenziale.
